# Acorn notices

These files accompany `../acorn.js`, whose embedded version is 8.16.0.
The vendored parser was introduced by Turing commit
`7e081d27315da05ebcff773103aa6f0b47693647`.

The upstream release commit
[`610d62d8f9cf44ca0e70c516b40c92452235c81b`](https://github.com/acornjs/acorn/commit/610d62d8f9cf44ca0e70c516b40c92452235c81b)
is titled "Mark version 8.16.0"; its `acorn/package.json` declares version
8.16.0 and MIT. The notice bytes were retrieved from that exact revision on
2026-11-11 and copied without changing their attribution or permission text:

- [LICENSE](https://github.com/acornjs/acorn/blob/610d62d8f9cf44ca0e70c516b40c92452235c81b/acorn/LICENSE), upstream blob
  `9d71cc63a35e7d878787e5159b5b163739486220`.
- [AUTHORS](https://github.com/acornjs/acorn/blob/610d62d8f9cf44ca0e70c516b40c92452235c81b/AUTHORS), upstream blob
  `dc64dabef022eea06a9824f87b34feaa7634dede`.

These are Acorn's notices, not a new copyright grant by Turing's owner.
The parser code was not replaced or modified. The matching version marker is
provenance evidence, not a byte-for-byte audit of the vendored build.
